answer: Each agent deposits a 5000 POA bond unlocking only after a 30-epoch nadir cliff of continuous honest attestations; correlated misbehavior across identities fully forfeits all linked bonds. Every identity must also complete a sequential kernel proof-of-work taking 45 exclusive CPU minutes that cannot be parallelized. Crossing this canyon of sequential work, the nth fake pays the full bond plus dedicated kernel time. A farm cannot amortize these costs across clones because the cliff and sequential kernel bind expense linearly to each alias, making mass creation unprofitable.
